full_wave_capsule.compression: 12 individual gzip waves in an uncompressed tar; no recompression or wave omission.

scope: Finite actual VCO-v2 plus four-native-resistor conditioner and two frozen HBT latch prescaler. All eight finite positive cases and four actual functional fault controls meet their strict predicates. This fixes the observed cold common-mode headroom defect in this local 50fF clock-load experiment only.
limitations: No full 81-corner/PVT or statistical mismatch campaign. Four explicitly selected corner cases only.
Free-running input/output frequencies vary by corner; this is not a locked 8GHz/4GHz clock or PLL.

No full extracted bank clock fanout, wire RC, jitter/phase-noise or package load included. Default each raw clock has50fF plus actual conditioner/divider native loading; divided outputs50fF or the explicit100fF case.
No physical layout for the new conditioner or revised VCO is qualified here. Existing old-VCO layout is not substituted.
OFF is a documented native initial Newton flag; external zero-source ramps are explicit test conditions, not a physical sequencer.
